sentences.text:
Apparently, the order has already been passed on 26.03.2024 (Annexure R-2),
rejecting the claim as such on the ground that the essentiality and viability of the land in question, affects the planning of 45 meter wide road of Sector-9, Safidon, Jind.
The justification has been done and the site plan (Annexure R-1) has been appended.

4. Faced with this situation, learned counsel for the petitioners submits that he may be permitted to withdraw the present writ petition with liberty to file fresh petition to challenge the order, if, so desired.
The main prayer was for consideration of the representation, therefore, the same has been rendered infructuous.
5. The petition is disposed of with the liberty aforesaid.
